name: Restore the secure group workspace
description: Verifies a signed-in user can restore their session and reach the private NJAMA GROUP command centre.
steps: Sign in to NJAMA GROUP using the test account
Wait for the opening sequence and workspace to load
Confirm the signed-in workspace and navigation are visible
expected: The authenticated user reaches the group command centre without a sign-in loop or blank screen.

name: Navigate sections with Back and Next
description: Verifies navigation controls move between visited sections without leaving NJAMA GROUP.
steps: Use Back and confirm Businesses appears
Use Next and confirm Governance appears
expected: Back and Next move through visited NJAMA GROUP sections; neither control exits the app.

name: Keep Android and browser Back inside the app
description: Verifies the device or browser Back action returns to the previous group section rather than leaving the parent app.
steps: Open NJAMA GROUP on a mobile viewport
Use the device or browser Back action
expected: The previous NJAMA GROUP section is displayed and the app remains open.

name: Show the branded opening sequence
description: Verifies the branded opening screen appears before the authenticated workspace and respects reduced-motion preferences.
steps: Observe the emblem, wordmark and progress animation
Wait for the workspace to appear
expected: A restrained NJAMA GROUP opening sequence appears, then the app continues to sign-in or the restored workspace.

name: Use the command centre on a laptop or desktop
description: Verifies the parent command centre is usable at laptop and desktop widths.
steps: Open NJAMA GROUP at a desktop viewport
Check that the sidebar, content, cards and history controls remain visible and usable
expected: The desktop layout uses the available width cleanly, with working sidebar and Back/Next controls and no horizontal overflow.
